Dear Sirs,  
 
We refer to our intimation dated August 10, 2026, informing about the conference call to be hosted by 
the Company on August 13, 2026 to discuss the financial results of the Company for the quarter ended 
June 30, 2026. 
 
In this connection, pursuant to the provisions of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, as amended, the Company has uploaded the audio recording of the 
conference call hosted by it on August 13, 2026, to discuss the financial results of the Company for the 
quarter ended June 30, 2026, on its website. The said audio recording can be accessed through the below 
mentioned web address: 
 
https://www.sammaancapital.com/call-and-recordings  
 
The transcript of the said conference call will be submitted, in due course. 
 
Please take the aforesaid intimation on record. 
  
Thanking you, 
 
Yours faithfully,
